summary: Roblox Corp filed an 8-K announcing a board-authorized share repurchase program of up to $3 billion of its Class A common stock, with an initial intent to buy $1 billion over the next 12 months. The program is designed to partially offset dilution from employee equity grants while preserving growth investment flexibility. Repurchases may occur through open market transactions, privately negotiated deals, or Rule 10b5-1 plans. The program has no fixed expiration and can be suspended at any time. No advisor, premium, or price per share was specified. Watch for execution pace and potential impact on share price.
